name: Logowall
description: Wall of client/partner logos as a static grid (3-6 columns), an auto-scrolling marquee with masked edges, a compact single row without header, or a paginated prev/next slider.
when_to_use: Social proof through recognizable brands — 'Trusted by' rows near the top or references further down. Use Credibility (certificates) when the logos are certifications rather than clients.
capabilities: marquee: continuously scrolling logo track with fade-out edge masks
paginated slider with prev/next arrows and 4/6/8 logos per page

variants.description: Static grid; columns setting picks 3-6 columns. Default.
Auto-scrolling row (logos duplicated for a seamless loop), edges masked.
Single row without the header block.
Paginated with prev/next arrows; per_page sets 4/6/8 logos per page.

breakpoints.mobile: Grid collapses to 2-3 columns; marquee keeps scrolling.

ai.prompt_summary: Logowall: partner/client logo wall. Settings: variant (grid|marquee|compact|slider), eyebrow, headline, intro, columns (3|4|5|6, grid only), per_page (4|6|8, slider only). Logos in logos[] (min 1): { label (alt text fallback), image (svg/png/webp/jpg), url (optional link) }.
ai.content_guidelines: 6-12 logos; prefer SVG for crispness. Labels are company names (used as alt text). Skip headline for the compact variant — it is not rendered there.

field_hints.logos.label: Company name; serves as the alt-text fallback.
field_hints.columns: Only applies to the grid variant.
field_hints.per_page: Only applies to the slider variant.
